name: loom-runtime
description: loom's runtime piece: boxes and houses, model accounts, harness runners, model choice and delivery

loom.name: runtime
loom.label: Runtime
loom.description: The runtime: the machines (boxes) and containers (houses) agents run in, their model accounts, the harnesses that run a body, which model it runs on, and delivery: anything addressed to an agent becomes a body handling it.

settings.name: LOOM_RUNTIME_LOOM_URL
settings.label: loom's MCP URL, as this machine reaches it

settings.name: LOOM_RUNTIME_PUBLIC_URL
settings.label: loom's URL for other boxes
settings.hint: what a new box joins, e.g. https://loom.example.com

settings.name: LOOM_RUNTIME_ACCOUNTS
settings.label: Model accounts
settings.hint: unset: the accounts the boxes' logins report (docs/model-accounts.md); none: don't read quota

settings.name: LOOM_RUNTIME_TOKEN_FILE
settings.label: A runtime token, for core's conversation records and scorecards
settings.hint: a file holding a token with loom's runtime role; without one, delivery writes no turns (and answers 503) and model choice reads no scorecards

settings.name: LOOM_RUNTIME_BUSY_LIMIT
settings.label: Bodies an agent has mid-turn before a new conversation waits

settings.name: LOOM_RUNTIME_WARM_IDLE_S
settings.label: Seconds a body whose turn is over stays warm

settings.name: LOOM_RUNTIME_CONTINUITY
settings.label: How long a conversation's slot is kept, in days
settings.hint: JSON by venue or venue kind, e.g. {"slack": 7, "scheduled": 1}; at most 14 (default live 14, scheduled 1, agent 3)

settings.name: LOOM_RUNTIME_BODY_ENV
settings.label: More of the runtime's environment a body may have
settings.hint: variable names, comma-separated; never LOOM_*, a harness's settings or a provider's key (a body in a house runs in the house's own environment)
